name: Spring Pop Words
description: Three short words spring up from 45% scale, untilting with one ~12% overshoot and a tiny second swing.
move: Three short words spring up from 45% scale, untilting with one ~12% overshoot and a tiny second swing.
how: A custom ease 1 - e^(-7t)·cos(10.5t), normalised to end exactly at 1, drives scale 0.45→1, rotation -7→0 and y 40→0 over 1.2s, stagger 0.22. Opacity resolves in 0.25s. Exit: scale 0.82, blur and fade.
adapt: Best for 2–4 short words. Raise the decay (7) for less bounce; raise the frequency (10.5) for a snappier wobble. Placeholder copy is generic; replace it with the product's words. Colours come from the palette tokens at the top of the page (--bg, --surface, --ink, --muted, --accent, --accent-2); change those to re-brand it.
port: All motion is inline in index.html. GSAP pages: register the CustomEase curves, scope selectors to the shot element and rebuild the same timeline; the split helper is inline and dependency-free.
caveats: Original implementation of the After Effects "Pop / bounce in by word" idea; no AE preset files, expressions or numbers are copied and fidelity to a specific AE render is not claimed.
Starts and ends on an empty stage so it loops cleanly; trim the exit when the next shot cuts in.
